The '''Bolotaur Beach''' was an area next to a river in the jungles of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was populated by many aggressive [[bolotaur]]s.<ref name="SWG:CSD">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Collecting Survey Data|Kashyyyk}}</ref>

Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Doctor [[Farnsworth]] had set up a survey device in this area to collect data about the environment. When his survey devices stopped sending signals, Farnsworth asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to travel to the devices and download the data from the devices' memory banks.<ref name="SWG:CSD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bolotaur Beach was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CSD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was added to the game in the [[2005]] expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']]. The name of the area was revealed during the quest [[:w:c:swg:Collecting Survey Data|Collecting Survey Data]] for Doctor Farnsworth.<ref name="SWG:CSD" />
